Job Description:

• Being a main contributor to Head of Branch on Business Strategic Development volume Sales Area
• Collaborate with Distribution Partner to develop existing cluster with target growth Reload.
• Monitor and ensure availability & visibility of Indosat product in cluster including monitor card distribution to all distro / outlet in the respective cluster
• Advocate all sales channel related all Indosat promotion & products
• Strengthen retail penetration (open new outlet) and outlet engagement (Indosat promo or products as main preferable sale by outlet)
• Educate distributor’s team to comply with distributor KPI (training, coaching, & counseling)
• Direct & guide distributor to deliver activities in the cluster including brand activities, sales event, happening art, bundling program and community program
• Monitor network availability and escalate to Head of Branch and Function Sales Assurance in Region for any network problem in the respective cluster
• Compiling daily reports and send to Head of Branch and related function in Region
• Coordinate with Rural GTM Executive (RGE) for any requirement regarding marketing promotion / branding in the respective cluster
• Execute and achieve functional goals given by managers
• Provide continuous inputs on business process and systems improvement

Qualification:

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in Sales.
• Experience in telecommunications or related industry is preferred.
• Min. bachelor’s degree
• Able to demonstrate leadership role in recent projects which involve cross functional effort within the company
• Good understanding of commercial operation of the business and able to work in different roles within the Group
• Has driving license (Sim A & C) is mandatory

wo-jpfa-JR1068.d:
Job Descriptions :

1. Monitor the availability and inventory of raw materials, auxiliary materials, and premixes using FIFO/FEFO principles.
2. Coordinate warehouse operations, including unloading, loading, storage, and material verification.
3. Ensure proper material classification, inventory accuracy, and report shrinkage or aged packaging/labels.
4. Prepare daily warehouse reports while maintaining compliance with OHS and 5S standards.
5. Supervise warehouse staff and drive continuous improvement through performance monitoring and process innovation.

Qualifications :

1. Minimum Vocational (D3/D4) or Bachelor's degree (S1) in Industrial Engineering / Statistics / Management / Accounting

2. Have experience as Raw Material Coordinator minimum 3 years / Procurement Staff minimum 3 years

3. Ability in English (verbal & written)

4. Willing to work in dynamic factory environment and in East Java

Deskripsi Pekerjaan:

1. Memantau ketersediaan dan persediaan bahan baku, bahan pembantu, dan premix dengan menerapkan prinsip FIFO/FEFO.
2. Mengoordinasikan operasional gudang, termasuk proses bongkar muat, penyimpanan, dan verifikasi material.
3. Memastikan klasifikasi material yang tepat, keakuratan stok, serta melaporkan penyusutan dan kemasan/label yang telah berumur.
4. Menyusun laporan harian gudang serta memastikan penerapan standar K3 dan 5S.
5. Mengawasi kinerja staf gudang dan mendorong perbaikan berkelanjutan melalui pemantauan kinerja dan inovasi proses.

Kualifikasi:

1. Minimal Diploma (D3/D4) atau Sarjana (S1) di bidang Teknik Industri, Statistika, Manajemen, atau Akuntansi.
2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun sebagai Koordinator Bahan Baku atau Staf Procurement.
3. Mampu berbahasa Inggris, baik lisan maupun tulisan.
4. Bersedia bekerja di lingkungan pabrik yang dinamis dan di area Jawa Timur

wo-jpfa-JR3714.d:
Job Summary**

Responsible for providing comprehensive administrative and operational support across various HR functions to ensure efficient and effective HR services within PT Santosa Agrindo.

Job Responsibilities**

* Assist in the recruitment and selection process, including posting job advertisements, screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and conducting background checks.
* Prepare and process new employee onboarding documentation and conduct new hire orientations.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records in the HR information system (HRIS) and personnel files, ensuring data integrity and confidentiality.
* Administer employee benefits programs, including health insurance, leave management, and other welfare schemes.
* Support payroll processing by collecting and verifying timekeeping data, leave requests, and other relevant information.
* Assist in the preparation of HR reports and analyses as required.
* Handle employee inquiries regarding HR policies, procedures, and benefits.
* Support the performance management process, including tracking performance reviews and related documentation.
* Assist in organizing and coordinating HR-related events, training sessions, and employee engagement activities.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws and company policies and procedures.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Management, or a related field.
* Proven experience (1-3 years) in an HR generalist or administrative role, preferably within the agricultural or manufacturing sector.
* Strong understanding of HR principles, practices, and Indonesian labor laws.
* Proficiency in using HRIS and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maintain a high degree of integrity.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
* Proactive and team-oriented with a strong customer service mindset.
